QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Colossal Clean Up 7
QuestInfo.0: You'll have to get to the root of the problem to save the Stone Colossus. Talk to #bStone Colossus#k one more time at #bStone Colossus Arm#k.
QuestInfo.1: The Stone Colossus believes that an evil creature has taken up residence in its heart. Enter the #bStone Colossus Heart#k.
QuestInfo.2:
You met the great spirit Guwaru in Stone Colossus Heart.

Guwaru was corrupted at one point and was the Black Mage's Commander. Due to that evil influence, the Black Mage's magic managed to corrupt the many spirits that make up Stone Colossus. After the Black Mage was sealed, Guwaru came to his senses and has been protecting Stone Colossus all this time.

Guwaru said he will no longer support the Black Mage and that his forces are dwindling. That is fortunate but, something feels off...

0.0: I am losing myself. The #rdarkness#k will control me soon.
0.1: I have one last request... Go inside my #bheart#k. It hurts... Something bad is there.

yes.0: I will hold out as long as I can.\r\n#b#e(Face the #rTarantulus#b in Stone Colossus Heart.)#k

no.0: I can't go on much longer...

1.0: Thank you. #bStone Colossus's pollution has been completely purified#k! We'll have to defeat the polluted beings that were already here, but at least no more will appear.
1.1: My task is done. I shall take my leave. And don't worry, #bI won't support the Black Mage anymore#k. I refuse to lose myself to the darkness again.
1.2: From the very start, the Black Mage has seemed uninterested in expanding his forces. I can only guess at his plan. One thing I am sure of is that #rwhatever it is reaches far beyond Maple World#k.
1.3: You who fight against the Black Mage. Please be careful. I hope someday I can help you. Farewell...

mob.0: I have a request. Go inside my #bheart#k. It hurts... Something bad is there.\r\n#b#e(Face the #rTarantulus#b in Stone Colossus Heart.)#k
